note: Neighbor requests and rumors for Meadow. Spots are Main Street node ids behind the plaza. {gift}, {cat}, {item}, {spot} and {manager} are filled in by the game.

rumors.text: Heard a kitten mewing by the Old Oak. Probably nothing. Probably a kitten.
Somebody dropped their coin purse under the Old Oak. Finders keepers?
The Old Oak has a hollow. Squirrels hide things there. Big things.
A tiny cat is sulking by the Lily Pond. Apparently the frog was rude.
Something shiny is stuck in the reeds at Lily Pond. Not a fish. Shinier.
Something washed up at Lily Pond. The ducks are guarding it badly.
There's a kitten on Hilltop Lookout counting clouds. It's lost count.
A picnic basket blew up to Hilltop Lookout. The sandwiches didn't make it.
Somebody buried something on Hilltop Lookout. The X was very obvious.

found.kitten: Found a kitten! It's {cat}, and {cat} is checking in at the hotel.
found.kittenKnown: Found a kitten! It already knows the way to your hotel. Here's a tip: 100 coins.
found.lost_item: Found a coin purse! No name inside. 80 Cat Coins, finders keepers.
found.treasure: Found a {item}! It's in storage now.

fetch: Could you bring me a {gift}? Paw Mart has them. I'd go, but... effort.
I need a {gift}. Don't ask why. It's a whole story.
Would you fetch me a {gift}? I'll owe you. Emotionally.

builds.text: Your hotel needs more green! Two new plants, please.
Your hotel's dark at night. Two more lanterns? For the moths.
My feet hurt just looking at your garden. Two more seats?
Your guests look bored. One new toy would fix that.
A fountain would be lovely. Or a pool. Wet things, basically.
Every cat deserves something soft. Add one more cozy thing?

thanks: You did it! You're the best manager on Main Street!
Perfect! I owe you one. Here, take this before I change my mind.
Wonderful! I'm telling everyone. Loudly. From the square.
